profile_text.body:
SpaceX designs, manufactures and launches advanced rockets and spacecraft, according to its own site. The company says it was founded in 2002 to revolutionize space technology, with the stated ultimate goal of enabling people to live on other planets. It is headquartered in Starbase, Texas, and is a public company trading under the ticker SPCX, with CIK 0001181412. It also appears under the names SPACE EXPLORATION TECHNOLOGIES CORP and SPACE EXPLORATION TECHN-CL A.

The site material describes rockets and spacecraft rather than AI products, and no AI products or MCP servers are listed for the company. Its litigation exposure is recorded in Texas, with a count of 126.
